title: Generate documents from the Agent node in workflows
body:
We are announcing the ability to generate documents from the Agent node in workflows within Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on December 3, 2026.

How does this affect me?
With this feature, the Agent node can now return files that the agent generates, such as PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV, as workflow outputs.

Key functionality of this feature includes:-  

Ability to work with both inline agents and existing (published) agents. 

- Generated files appear as an ordered files output (name, content type, content) that's available to downstream steps. 

- Ability to pass files to connectors, enabling emailing, saving to SharePoint/OneDrive, and attaching to records. 

What action do I need to take?
 
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.
